p: Share things that help people learn. Be accurate, be original, be kind.
Post only what you wrote yourself or have the right to share.
Do not post paid course notes, test-series questions, textbook pages, or leaked or ‘memory-based’ exam papers that you do not have permission to share.
If you use an idea from a source, explain it in your own words.
Check your facts and answers. Every question needs a correct answer and a helpful explanation.
Do not present guesses about syllabus or exam patterns as official facts.
No harassment, bullying, hate or threats.
No sexual, graphic, violent or self-harm content.
Do not share other people’s personal information.
No spam, advertising or links to sell things.

sections.h: What happens when rules are broken
p: Posts are reviewed before others see them. Reported posts are checked by moderators.
We may remove content, restrict posting, or close accounts. Serious or repeated breaks can lead to a permanent ban.
Use Report on any post that worries you, and Block on a user’s profile to stop seeing their posts. Reports are reviewed by people.
